text: OVERDOSAGE The signs and symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot and dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, and CNS stimulation. Call your doctor or local Poison Control Center if overdosage is suspected. The dosage of PHENOHYTRO ® ELIXIR should be adjusted to the needs of the individual patient to assure symptomatic control with a minimum of adverse effects.
